subject: Wire grader to opportunistic pressure-nudge (mirror the judge)
description: Make scripts/gate-label.js self-run via the judge's pressure-nudge mechanism instead of the nightly cron. (1) New routes/label.js mirroring routes/judge.js: /label/pressure GET returns {depth, nudge, harness_task_key:'followup/harness-label-drain'}, where depth = unlabeled journal rows whose task_key is terminal, 1/hour throttle, threshold ~10; plus ensureHarnessLabelDrainTask standing task. Register in daemon.js routeModules. (2) hooks/classify.sh: add a [Grader] nudge block mirroring the [Judge] block, dispatching ONE background grader pass that runs `node scripts/gate-label.js` and claims/completes followup/harness-label-drain. (3) test/label-pressure.test.js mirroring test/judge-pressure.test.js. Explicitly NOT wiring nightly QA. Daemon restart to activate the new route is a separate disruptive step.
